sources.snippet: Sahayak AI - Your Indian AI Assistant Sahayak AI is a modern, production-quality AI-powered web application designed to solve real daily-life problems for Indian users. Built with cutting-edge technologies and designed with emotional, accessible interfaces, it supports students, creators, first-time internet users, and everyday citizens.

sources.title: inbharatai/sahaayak-ai-public - GitHub
sources.snippet: Sahaayak (सहायक — "helper" in Hindi) is a multilingual personal AI operating system initially designed for 1.4 billion Indian users, now ready to scale globally. It combines AI chat, voice, document scanning, translation, notes, tasks, emails, and news into one seamless workspace — transcending language barriers everywhere.
